Ohio State.why: Julian Sayin is listed OUT on the Big Ten initial availability report for Northwestern; no injury type was released. Freshman Luke Fahey has started the last two games.
Ohio State.timeline: Short term; Ohio State has not given a return date.
Ohio State.starts: 2 starts, 0-2 (L 18-30 USC, L 28-41 Oregon); 57 of 88, 620 yards, 3 TD, 1 INT; 360 yards on 36 of 50 at Oregon
Ohio State.src: Big Ten availability report via ABC6 and Yahoo Sports (Nov 12 to 13); ESPN box scores

Northwestern.why: Aidan Chiles is listed OUT on the Big Ten initial availability report; he has not played since the Oct 31 loss at Oregon. No injury type released.
Northwestern.timeline: Out a second straight game; no return date given.
Northwestern.starts: 1 start, 0-1 (L 10-24 Iowa); 24 of 32, 181 yards, 1 TD, 0 INT
Northwestern.src: Big Ten availability report via ABC6 and Yahoo Sports; ESPN box scores

Michigan.why: Benched, not injured: Bryce Underwood lost the job after early season struggles; ESPN's Pete Thamel reports Carr is expected to start at Oregon with Underwood also expected to play.
Michigan.timeline: Coaching decision. ESPN (Thamel, Nov 10) expects Underwood to also play; On3 via RotoWire (Nov 10) says Underwood stays on the bench. Treat Underwood snaps as possible, not certain.
Michigan.starts: 3 starts, 1-2 (W 28-21 Rutgers, L 6-15 Michigan State); 56 of 85, 571 yards, 1 TD, 3 INT
Michigan.src: ESPN (Nov 10); On3 via RotoWire (Nov 10); ESPN box scores

Wisconsin.why: Colton Joseph has an undisclosed injury and was benched in the second half at Iowa; freshman Ryan Hopkins made his first start Nov 7. Joseph was available only in an emergency role last week.
Wisconsin.timeline: Fickell named Hopkins the starter for Maryland on Nov 9 (ESPN); still the starter on Nov 13 (National Football Post). Joseph, still dealing with an undisclosed injury, stays in the offensive plan, so both may play.
Wisconsin.starts: 1 start, 1-0 (W 31-10 Rutgers); 18 of 24, 241 yards, 3 TD, 0 INT
Wisconsin.src: ESPN (Nov 9), National Football Post (Nov 13); ESPN box scores

Florida.why: Aaron Philo was hurt the week before Texas (injury not disclosed), then was pulled at Georgia after two interceptions; Tramell Jones Jr. started at Oklahoma.
Florida.timeline: Coaching decision with an injury in the background; no return date for Philo.
Florida.starts: 3 starts, 1-2 (incl. W 27-24 at Texas, L 7-23 Oklahoma); 50 of 82, 460 yards, 2 TD, 3 INT
Florida.src: ClutchPoints citing CBS Sports (Nov 5); ESPN box scores

Texas Tech.why: Benched, not injured: Will Hammond (6-0 to start) was benched after a 227 yard, 1 INT loss to Cincinnati; Castellanos is listed QB1 on the depth chart.
Texas Tech.timeline: Coaching decision; Castellanos is the starter going forward.
Texas Tech.starts: 2 starts, 2-0 (W 34-26 Arizona, W 53-48 West Virginia); 29 of 51, 506 yards, 7 TD, 0 INT, plus 117 rushing yards vs Arizona
Texas Tech.src: ClutchPoints citing On3 (Nov 1); ESPN box scores

Arizona State.why: Cutter Boley was benched in October and Mikey Keene hurt his knee against Kansas State; freshman Jake Fette has started the last two games and coach Kenny Dillingham said he has earned the job.
Arizona State.timeline: Keene knee injury, no return date; Boley benched.
Arizona State.starts: 2 starts, 1-1 (L 20-27 BYU, W 20-10 Colorado); 35 of 61, 353 yards, 3 TD, 0 INT
Arizona State.src: Field Level Media (Nov 5), Arizona Sports; ESPN box scores; Odds API posted Fette props

UCF.why: Barnett III is UCF's No. 1 when healthy: he missed five games with a hamstring injury from Sept 12, returned Nov 7. Keyone Jenkins (6 starts) aggravated an ankle injury vs Baylor and was questionable.
UCF.timeline: Barnett listed back and healthy, no designation (Nov 13 report); Jenkins questionable, freshman Rocco Marriott next if both sit.
UCF.starts: 3 starts, 2-1 (incl. W 33-32 at Kansas); 49 of 80, 595 yards, 4 TD, 2 INT
UCF.src: Sports Illustrated UCF availability breakdown (Nov 13); Field Level Media (Nov 5); ESPN box scores

Kansas State.why: Avery Johnson has missed four straight games with an injury K-State has not described; coach Chris Klein said Nov 3 there is only an outside chance he returns this season. Jacob Knuth started once, Blake Barnett the last two.
Kansas State.timeline: Johnson likely out for the season.
Kansas State.starts: 2 starts, 0-2 (L 24-27 OT Colorado, L 28-66 Oklahoma State); 25 of 45, 330 yards, 4 TD, 2 INT

Mississippi State.why: Kamario Taylor is out for the season after foot surgery (hurt vs Oklahoma). AJ Swann led the last game; freshman Billy Puckett also started twice.
Mississippi State.timeline: Taylor out for season, expected full recovery for 2027.
Mississippi State.starts: 2 starts, 0-2 (L 3-31 Texas, L 23-25 Vanderbilt); 35 of 51, 351 yards, 2 TD, 1 INT
Mississippi State.src: WLOX (Oct 27); ESPN box scores; Odds API posted Swann props

Wake Forest.why: Lopez sat out the Merrimack game as a precaution with a lower body injury not viewed as long term; ESPN reported he should be available to start at SMU.
Wake Forest.timeline: Coach Jake Dickert on Nov 9: he will be ready to go Saturday (Yahoo Sports, Nov 12). No official designation; Steele Pizzella is the fallback.
Wake Forest.starts: QB1: 8 starts, 7-1, 2,176 yards, 18 TD, 1 INT; Steele Pizzella started once (W 77-0 Merrimack, 432 yards)
Wake Forest.src: Yahoo Sports (Nov 12) quoting Jake Dickert; ClutchPoints citing ESPN (Nov 7); Odds API posted Lopez props

Boise State.why: Madsen hurt his knee in the Nov 1 win over Texas State and missed Colorado State; Max Cutforth started Nov 7 (W 64-38, 16 of 19, 317 yards, 4 TD). Madsen was listed questionable on the initial Pac-12 report but practiced this week; coach Spencer Danielson said the team feels really good about where he is.
Boise State.timeline: Questionable on the Pac-12 report, expected to start; the gameday report decides. Cutforth is the fallback.
Boise State.src: ESPN (Nov 11, Pac-12 availability report); ClutchPoints citing ESPN (Nov 6); ESPN box scores

James Madison.why: No official reason: Coleman (8 starts) did not play at Southern Miss after two overtime losses with three interceptions; he was not on an injury report. JC Evans started and JMU won 54-23.
James Madison.timeline: Unclear; JMU has not said whether this is a benching or an injury.
James Madison.starts: 2 starts, 2-0 (W 54-23 Southern Miss); 26 of 35, 312 yards, 2 TD, 0 INT

Air Force.why: Liam Szarka is out for the season with a lower leg injury (Covers, Oct 5). Air Force rarely throws; Medders led the passing in the Nov 8 win over Army.
Air Force.starts: 1 game leading the passing, 1-0 (W 24-21 Army); 6 of 8, 84 yards, 1 TD
Air Force.src: Covers injury report (Oct 5); ESPN box scores

Rutgers.why: Dylan Lonergan was hurt in September (Rutgers started Surace in his place, Sept 8) and Surace has led the last games; Lonergan's current status was not found in news at run time.
Rutgers.src: ESPN and Field Level Media (Sept 8); ESPN box scores

Utah State.why: Hillstead was named Utah State's 2026 starter in April; Grady Brosterhous started six games while Hillstead was not the starter earlier this season (reason not found in news at run time). Hillstead has started the last three.
Utah State.timeline: Settled as the starter for now.
Utah State.starts: 3 starts, 2-1 (W 31-14 Colorado State, W 17-10 Fresno State); 41 of 66, 468 yards, 3 TD, 3 INT
Utah State.src: Utah State Athletics (Apr 20), theScore; ESPN box scores

Kennesaw State.why: Varnes replaced Rickie Collins during the Nov 7 game and threw the winning 63 yard touchdown in a 42-40 win over Delaware; Collins (5 of 7 that day) has not been reported injured. Kennesaw State has not named a starter publicly at run time.
Kennesaw State.starts: 1 start, 1-0 (W 42-40 Delaware); 19 of 37, 254 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT
Kennesaw State.src: AP via yourvalley.net (Nov 7); ESPN box scores

Rice.why: Freshman Gael Ochoa led Rice's last game (8 of 13, 172 yards at North Texas); Jacurri Brown started five games (0-5). No news on the change was found at run time.
Rice.timeline: Unknown; Rice runs an option-heavy offense with few passes either way.
Rice.starts: 1 start, 0-1 (L 23-52 North Texas); 8 of 13, 172 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT
Rice.src: ESPN box scores; no news found

Oregon State.why: Injury: Braden Atkinson hurt his hand in the 42-21 loss to Texas State; he was listed doubtful on the initial Pac-12 availability report and ESPN's Pete Thamel reported him ruled out for Boise State. Senior Maalik Murphy relieved him in that game.
Oregon State.timeline: Short term hand injury, no return date reported. The Pac-12 gameday report decides; Murphy is the likely starter.
Oregon State.starts: 0 starts this season; in relief vs Texas State 5 of 7, 75 yards, 0 TD, 1 INT (about 5% of team attempts)
Oregon State.starter_season: Atkinson: 9 starts, 5-4, 3,169 yards (leads the nation), 25 TD, 3 INT
Oregon State.src: ESPN (Nov 11, initial Pac-12 report: Atkinson doubtful, Madsen questionable); KATU citing ESPN's Pete Thamel (Nov 12); RotoWire (not expected to play)
